question: The value of [-11 + 2 - 12 ÷ 4] × 5 is:
solution:
**Given:**

[-11 + 2 - 12 ÷ 4] × 5 

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e7a20e61846c6ccd67207a3bc8b140be1db7470dc5524d0e4aa6bcd15a3ce09.png] 

**Given:**

According to the question

⇒ [-11 + 2 - 12 ÷ 4] × 5 

⇒ [-11 + 2 - 3] × 5

⇒ [-9 - 3] × 5 = -12 × 5 = -60

**∴ The required result will be -60.**
